description: This file defines the ThemeController class for managing themes in a Drupal system, including installing, uninstalling, and setting default themes.

classes.name: ThemeController
classes.description: Controller class for handling theme management operations such as install, uninstall, and setting default themes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting theme handler, theme list, config factory, and theme installer services.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls a specified theme if it is not the default or admin theme.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs a specified theme, with handling for experimental themes and dependency errors.

methods.name: willInstallExperimentalTheme
methods.description: Checks if the theme or its dependencies are experimental and require confirmation.

methods.name: setDefaultTheme
methods.description: Sets a specified theme as the default theme, with confirmation for experimental themes.
